merge_requests.title: FRD-101 implement fraud scoring model pipeline
merge_requests.description:
Implements the end-to-end fraud scoring model pipeline.

## Changes
- XGBoost model training pipeline with Optuna hyperparameter tuning
- ONNX export for production serving on mfs-fraud-pod-01 and mfs-fraud-pod-02
- MLflow experiment tracking integration
- Feature preprocessing pipeline reading from mfs_fraud_db on pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal
- Service account: svc-fraud-engine
- Deployment target: mfs-prod namespace

## Database
- Reads training data from mfs_fraud_db.fraud_transactions
- Writes model metadata to mfs_fraud_db.model_registry

Related: FRD-101, CHG0090401

merge_requests.title: FRD-102 real-time feature extraction service
merge_requests.description:
Real-time feature extraction service for fraud scoring.

## Changes
- Kafka consumer for 'mfs.txn.raw' topic
- Feature computation: velocity, merchant risk, device fingerprint, geolocation anomaly
- Writes enriched features to 'mfs.txn.features' topic
- Service runs on mfs-fraud-pod-01 under svc-fraud-engine
- Shared utilities in mfs-common-libs

## Infrastructure
- Pod: mfs-fraud-pod-01 (mfs-prod namespace)
- DB: reads reference data from mfs_fraud_db on pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal

Related: FRD-102

merge_requests.title: FRD-103 model versioning and A/B testing framework
merge_requests.description:
Model versioning system with A/B testing traffic splitting.

## Changes
- Model registry with version metadata and performance baselines
- Traffic router with configurable split percentages
- Metric collection per model variant
- Automated rollback when new model underperforms baseline
- Integration with svc-model-serving on mfs-model-pod-01

## Database
- Model versions stored in mfs_fraud_db.model_versions
- A/B test results in mfs_fraud_db.ab_test_results

Related: FRD-103

merge_requests.title: FRD-201 transaction velocity monitor implementation
merge_requests.description:
Transaction velocity monitoring with sliding time windows.

## Changes
- Velocity tracking per account, merchant, and device dimensions
- Sliding windows: 1min, 5min, 1hr, 24hr
- Configurable threshold rules in YAML with hot-reload
- Kafka consumer for 'mfs.txn.enriched' topic
- Alert publishing to 'mfs.alerts.txn' topic

## Infrastructure
- Pod: mfs-txn-mon-pod-01 (mfs-prod namespace)
- Service account: svc-txn-monitor
- DB: mfs_fraud_db on pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal

Related: FRD-201, CHG0090501

merge_requests.title: FRD-202 anomaly detection alert system
merge_requests.description:
Anomaly detection system with statistical pattern analysis.

## Changes
- Z-score based anomaly detection on transaction amounts and frequencies
- Isolation forest model for multivariate anomaly detection
- Severity classification: HIGH (>0.9), MEDIUM (0.7-0.9), LOW (<0.7)
- Alert routing to 'mfs.alerts.txn' Kafka topic
- Alert persistence to mfs_fraud_db.alerts table

## Infrastructure
- Pod: mfs-txn-mon-pod-01 (mfs-prod namespace)
- Service account: svc-txn-monitor

Related: FRD-202

merge_requests.title: FRD-301 AML rule engine implementation
merge_requests.description:
Core AML rule engine for pattern detection.

## Changes
- Structuring detection: identifies split transactions below $10,000 threshold
- Layering detection: tracks rapid inter-account fund movements
- Integration pattern detection: flags funds merged into legitimate transactions
- Rule definitions in declarative YAML with version history

## Infrastructure
- Pod: mfs-aml-pod-01 (mfs-prod namespace)
- Service account: svc-aml-engine
- DB: mfs_aml_db on pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal

Related: FRD-301, CHG0090601

merge_requests.title: FRD-302 suspicious activity reporting automation
merge_requests.description:
Automated SAR/CTR generation and FinCEN filing.

## Changes
- SAR form pre-population from AML case data
- CTR auto-filing for transactions > $10,000
- FinCEN BSA E-Filing system integration
- Narrative generation from detection rule outputs
- Batch submission with retry logic

## Infrastructure
- Pod: mfs-aml-pod-01 (mfs-prod namespace)
- Service account: svc-aml-engine
- DB: mfs_aml_db on pghost-prod-02.mfs.internal

Related: FRD-302
